title: spiraea blumei var. hayatae
intro: Spiraea blumei var. hayatae, commonly known as Korean spiraea, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used in Korean medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean spiraea include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of fever, as well as its use as an anti-diarrheal and anti-asthmatic agent. The bioactive constituents of Korean spiraea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
